faq.question: Can Birdcast support internal company podcasts?
faq.answer: Yes. Corporate podcasts can be created for employee communication, culture stories, leadership updates or internal education.

faq.question: Can external guests join the recording?
faq.answer: Yes, depending on the selected studio setup and format. Share the number of speakers before booking so the team can guide the setup.

faq.question: Can the same episode be used externally?
faq.answer: Yes. Corporate podcast content can be prepared for LinkedIn, websites, campaigns or client education when the intended channels are clear in advance.

faq.question: Should corporate teams book directly?
faq.answer: For simple sessions, booking can work. For branded or multi-speaker projects, WhatsApp first is better so the brief and setup are confirmed.

faq.question: Can Birdcast help structure the conversation?
faq.answer: Yes. The team can help clarify the episode flow, speaker pacing and production needs before the recording starts.
